label: input q at original positions 0-2
explanation: Fires exactly when the input token is the letter q at one of the first three original-phase positions (t = 0, 1, 2); dev P = R = 1.0. Magnitude is set by position: about 1.0 of max at t = 0 and roughly 0.92-0.97 at t = 1, but only about 0.35-0.45 at t = 2 (t = 2 holds a third of the activations but only 17% of the mass). Never fires on q at t >= 3, on any other token, or in the delimiter or copy phases (including when q is fed back as a copy-phase input).

issues: Minor: on the test split there are 2 missed activations, both at about 0.04 of max, where q is fed back as a copy-phase input at step 4 in L=3 sequences (e.g. 'q 3 z <DEL> [q:0.04] 3'). So 'never fires in the copy phase' is very slightly overstated. This is negligible: 0.0% of activation mass, recall 0.99996.

Test scores: precision 1.0, recall 0.99996, F1 0.99998, mass recall 0.999998. Dev profile backs up the other claims: no activity at t>=3 or in the delimiter/copy phases, only in_tok q is active, and t=2 has a third of the activations but 17% of the mass (t=0: 42%, t=1: 41%).
